title: List the long name of teams with above-average build-up play passing in 201
question:
List the long name of teams with above-average build-up play passing in 2012.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: long name of teams refers to team_long_name; build-up play passing refers to buildUpPlayPassing; above-average build-up play passing = buildUpPlayPassing > DIVIDE(SUM(buildUpPlayPassing), COUNT(team_long_name) WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL); in 2012 refers to strftime('%Y', date) = '2012';

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    T.XCL_173
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T
    ON TA.XCL_177 = T.XCL_171
WHERE
    TA.XCL_178 LIKE '2012%'
    AND TA.XCL_181 > (
        SELECT AVG(TA2.XCL_181)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
        WHERE TA2.XCL_178 LIKE '2012%'
    )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT t.XCL_173
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON ta.XCL_177 = t.XCL_171
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.XCL_178) = '2012'
  AND ta.XCL_183 > (
      SELECT AVG(XCL_183) FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE XCL_183 IS NOT NULL
        AND strftime('%Y', XCL_178) = '2012'
  );
